title: Use Data from a Report inside your Spreadsheet with Business Central  (Advanced Spreadsheets)

chapters.title: Creating a Report Region in Spreadsheet
Creating a Chart from Report Data

features.name: Report Region in Advanced Spreadsheets
features.description: Allows users to embed report data directly inside a spreadsheet. Users can select a report region, choose which report to display, set maximum rows, and include headers.

features.name: Query Region in Advanced Spreadsheets
features.description: Similar to report regions, users can also embed data from queries inside their spreadsheet. If a query inside the system calculates something, that data can be retrieved and displayed.

features.name: Chart Creation from Report Data
features.description: Users can create charts directly from report data embedded in spreadsheets. Demonstrated with a donut chart showing top customers with data pulled from a report and categories set to customer names.

features.name: Live Report Calculation and Refresh
features.description: Reports embedded in spreadsheets are calculated and refreshed dynamically. Each time the spreadsheet is opened, the report is recalculated. Users can trigger manual recalculation with a button.

features.name: Report Filtering in Spreadsheets
features.description: Users can set filters on embedded reports inside spreadsheets, functioning the same as normal report filtering. Filters can reference cells in the spreadsheet.
caveats: cell reference capability mentioned but not fully demonstrated
